authoritative_state_note: Persist these files in durable storage. GitHub Actions cache must not be the authoritative state store.

files.purpose: Price-trigger episode, severity, direction, reentry, and notification deduplication state.
files.failure_impact: Loses episode and notification history; explicit bootstrap is required and transitions may be suppressed or repeated.

files.purpose: Stage B.1 RSI, volume, source, and technical-event transition state.
files.failure_impact: Loses technical transition and deduplication history; explicit bootstrap is required.

files.purpose: Confirmed daily/weekly divergence signatures and escalation history.
files.failure_impact: Loses known divergence signatures; explicit bootstrap is required and notifications may repeat.

files.purpose: Timestamp, run ID, and coverage of the latest fully successful pipeline run.
files.failure_impact: Health monitoring reports RADAR_HEARTBEAT_MISSED until the next successful run.

files.purpose: Atomic current/last-run ledger, failure stage, coverage, counts, and telemetry.
files.failure_impact: Last-run degradation and audit status are unavailable until the next run.

files.purpose: Durable notification batch, provider acknowledgement, and retry-suppression ledger.
files.failure_impact: Delivery acknowledgement becomes unknown and retrying could duplicate a Telegram message.

files.purpose: Transient single-run exclusion lock with stale-lock recovery metadata.
files.failure_impact: Without lock coordination on a shared host, concurrent runs may mutate state simultaneously.
